description: This file provides functions to resolve and retrieve Git commit hashes, including reading from Git refs, package.json, and build info, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: formatCommit
methods.description: Formats a string to extract a short Git commit hash if valid.

methods.name: resolveCommitSearchDir
methods.description: Determines the directory to search for Git info based on options.

methods.name: safeReadFilePrefix
methods.description: Reads a prefix of a file safely, limiting bytes read.

methods.name: cacheGitCommit
methods.description: Caches a Git commit hash associated with a search directory.

methods.name: resolveGitLookupDepth
methods.description: Calculates the depth of a directory relative to the package root for Git lookup.

methods.name: readCommitFromGit
methods.description: Reads the current Git commit hash from the repository in a given directory.

methods.name: resolveGitRefsBase
methods.description: Resolves the base directory for Git refs, considering 'commondir'.

methods.name: resolveRefPath
methods.description: Resolves a Git ref path safely, preventing traversal attacks.

methods.name: readCommitFromPackageJson
methods.description: Reads the Git commit hash from package.json's gitHead or githead fields.

methods.name: readCommitFromBuildInfo
methods.description: Reads the commit hash from build-info.json files.

methods.name: resolveCommitHash
methods.description: Main exported function to resolve the current Git commit hash, using environment variables, cache, and fallback methods.
